'''Task Force Commander''' was a title held by [[Fordo|ARC-77]] during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]. It was given to him by [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during an important time in the battle.
